section.p: This sample documents the WeatherBand API's `/forecast` endpoint from the repository-level openapi.yaml. It demonstrates how to convert OpenAPI endpoints into DITA reference topics.

section.title: Endpoint: GET /forecast
section.codeblock: { "id": "1", "location": "Houston", "temp": 28, "conditions": "humid", "poetic_summary": "Sweltering heat wraps around the Bayou City like a thick blanket." }

section.title: How this was generated
section.p: For reproducibility, the OpenAPI spec is at the repo root (openapi.yaml). To generate DITA topics programmatically, use a small script to parse the OpenAPI file and emit DITA reference topics for each path.
